items.Sentence: Originally, an Imhoff Tank (similar to a large septic tank) was used to settle solids; effluent from the Imhoff Tank was discharged to ponds for biological treatment and percolation of wastewater.
The existing treatment system consists of an automated influent screen, flow meter, influent pump station, four aerated lagoons, a settling pond, and nine effluent rapid infiltration basins.
